data.name: Boston Harbor Moonlight Cruise
data.headline: All Ages! • 1.5 Hours •  "Sea" the stars! •Enjoy the night skyline from the water!
data.description: Join us for a beautiful 90 minute evening cruise of Boston Harbor under the stars. View Boston’s beautiful skyline of lights. Whether you’re ending your evening onboard or starting your night out, come Sea Boston with Mass Bay Lines.
data.what_is_included: Drinks are available for pre-purchase and also available to purchase on board
what_is_included_items: Drinks are available for pre-purchase and also available to purchase on board
data.cancellation_notes: You can cancel up to 24 hours in advance of the experience for a full refund. For a full refund, you must cancel at least 24 hours before the experience’s start time. If you cancel less than 24 hours before the experience’s start time, the amount you paid will not be refunded. Any changes made less than 24 hours before the experience’s start time will not be accepted.
